title: NTA Exam Calendar 2027 Released
vacancyDetails: Academic examination schedule for major NTA examinations in 2027.
documentsRequired: As notified for each exam separately
howToApply:
1. Visit the official NTA portal and check the 2027 exam calendar.
2. Note the exam-month and application timeline for each national entrance test.
3. Apply only when the relevant official notification is released.
4. Keep the admit card, photo ID and required documents ready.
shortDescription: NTA has released the official exam calendar for 2027. Candidates can check the schedule for major entrance and recruitment-related examinations here.
content:
National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the Exam Calendar 2027 for major national-level exams.

The calendar provides a broad overview of the tentative exam schedule for 2027, including important entrance tests and recruitment-related examinations handled by NTA and partner agencies.

Students and aspirants should check the official PDF and the detailed notification for each exam before applying or preparing for the test.
